howto.name: Upload an animated GIF
howto.text: Drop a .gif file up to 500 MB.

howto.name: PrivaTools converts via FFmpeg
howto.text: GIF frames become MP4 frames at the source frame rate. H.264 codec for universal compatibility.

howto.name: Download the MP4
howto.text: Typically 5-10x smaller than the source GIF, with smoother playback.

faq.a: MP4 is dramatically smaller (better compression), supports audio, and plays smoother. Most social platforms now auto-convert uploaded GIFs to MP4 anyway.

faq.q: Will the loop work in MP4?
faq.a: MP4 doesn't have built-in loop info — players decide. Embed with <video loop autoplay muted> to mimic GIF behavior on the web.
MP4 doesn't support transparency. Transparent pixels render against a black background. Use WebM with VP9 if you need alpha.
